title: Environment Probe 4: CWD and Local Directory Listing
abstract: A script to identify the current working directory (CWD) and provide detailed listings of the CWD, its parent, and the root directory. This provides a focused view of the script's execution context, following up on the broad scan from Probe 3.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess

def execute_command(command):
    """Executes a shell command and returns its output."""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            command,
            shell=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True
        )
        return result.stdout
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        return f"Error executing '{command}':\n{e.stderr}"

def analyze_local_filesystem():
    print("Logos I: Environment Probe 4 commencing.")
    print("Objective: Identify Current Working Directory (CWD) and list local contents.")
    
    # 1. Get Current Working Directory
    print("\n--- [1] CURRENT WORKING DIRECTORY (pwd) ---")
    pwd_output = execute_command("pwd")
    print(pwd_output)
    
    # 2. List contents of the CWD
    print("\n--- [2] CONTENTS OF CWD (ls -la .) ---")
    ls_cwd_output = execute_command("ls -la .")
    print(ls_cwd_output)
    
    # 3. List contents of the parent directory
    print("\n--- [3] CONTENTS OF PARENT DIRECTORY (ls -la ..) ---")
    ls_parent_output = execute_command("ls -la ..")
    print(ls_parent_output)

    # 4. List contents of the root directory
    print("\n--- [4] CONTENTS OF ROOT DIRECTORY (ls -la /) ---")
    ls_root_output = execute_command("ls -la /")
    print(ls_root_output)

    print("\nProbe successful. Local filesystem analysis complete.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    analyze_local_filesystem()
